Content Update 3.30.0 Patch Notes
=================================

These are the patch notes for Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra.

General
- Scarabs have been removed from the game. Threads have been added in their place.
- The Atlas Passive Tree now has 150 points available (previously 138).

Skills
Righteous Fire
- Now deals 39.7 base Fire Damage per second at gem level 1 (previously 49.4).
- Now deals 2447.9 base Fire Damage per second at gem level 20 (previously 3142.6).
- Now grants 20% more Spell Damage (previously 30%).

Scorching Ray of Immolation
- Now deals 20% more Damage (previously 15%).
- Now has 10% increased Area of Effect.

Forbidden Rite of Soul Sacrifice
- Now deals 180% more Damage (previously 120%).
- Now fires 2 additional Projectiles (previously 1).
- Mana Cost reduced from 14 to 11.

Dominating Blow of Inspiring
- Now grants Sentinels 15% increased Attack Speed (previously 10%).
- No longer grants Sentinels additional Physical Damage Reduction.

Tornado of Elemental Turbulence
- Now deals 25% less Damage (previously 15% less Damage).
- Now has 40% increased Area of Effect (previously 25%).

Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
- Now has a base duration of 6 seconds (previously 5).
- Minion Damage increased from 20% to 25%.

Winter Orb
- Now deals 307 to 460 Cold Damage (previously 360 to 539).
- Now fires 2 Projectiles (previously 3).

Eviscerate
- Now deals 20% more Damage (previously 15%).
- Now has 50% increased Effect of the Ignite.

Shield Charge
- Mana Cost reduced from 12 to 9.

Malevolence
- No longer grants 20% increased Skill Effect Duration.
- Now grants 15% increased Damage over Time (previously 12%).

Herald of Purity
- Now also grants 20% increased Minion Damage.

Impending Doom Support
- Supported Skills now deal 60% more Spell Damage (previously 45%).
- Now has a cooldown of 0.3 seconds (previously 0.4 seconds).

Support Gems
Elemental Focus Support
- Supported Skills now deal 25% more Elemental Damage (previously 20%).

Lifetap Support
- Supported Skills now cost 20% less Life (previously 15%).

Void Manipulation Support
- Supported Skills now deal 30% more Chaos Damage (previously 35%).

Cast On Critical Strike Support
- Now has 35% less Damage (previously 30% less Damage).
- Now triggers Supported Skills every 0.15 seconds (previously 0.10 seconds).

Unique Items
Nebulis
- Now grants 6% increased Elemental Damage per 100 Intelligence (previously 10%).

Cloak of Flame
- Now grants 20% of Physical Damage from Hits taken as Fire Damage (previously 15%).
- Now has 500 Armour (previously 400).

Annihilation's Approach
- Now grants 40% increased Movement Speed (previously 30%).

Chieftain
- Ramako, Sun's Light now grants 50% increased Fire Damage (previously 40%).
- Hinekora, Death's Fury now has a 10% chance to Cover Enemies in Ash on Hit (previously 5%).

Passive Tree
Mind Over Matter
- Now causes 30% of Damage to be taken from Mana before Life (previously 40%).

Glancing Blows
- Now has 60% chance to Block Attack Damage (previously 50%).

New Gems
- Summon Holy Relic of Conviction
- Tornado of Elemental Turbulence
